CustomField.label: Variant Order
CustomField.description: Evaluation order among the branch variants of ONE slot: lowest first, and the FIRST variant whose Show_When_JSON__c matches is the question asked. Order matters because two predicates may both be true, and "whichever row the query happened to return first" is not an answer an author can reason about. Ignored on a row with no Show_When_JSON__c (the default), of which there is at most one per slot per pack.
